long_biography.plain_text:
Euroherc gave Dubravko Grgić the platform to turn specialist knowledge of insurance claims into a regional business system. From that insurer, he helped shape a wider group spanning Croatia and Bosnia and Herzegovina, centred on non-life, life and health insurance.

The operating model connected motor insurance with leasing, vehicle finance, inspections, maintenance and repairs. Managers commonly held shares in the companies they led, preserving each member’s legal independence while giving management an ownership interest. Grgić also remains a board member of Grgić & Partneri and heads its Vienna office, alongside a professorship in insurance law at the University of Zenica.
